subject: Double legends with geom_line and geom_smooth

messages.author: 519455d3bf64680d
messages.subject: Double legends with geom_line and geom_smooth
parts:
Legend Challenges..

The following code works nicely to generate a single legend with a
multi-line legend title:

library(ggplot2)
str(diamonds)
ggplot(data=diamonds)+
geom_line(aes(x=price, y=table, colour=cut, group=cut, size=0))+
geom_smooth(aes(x=price, y=table, colour=cut, group=cut))+
scale_colour_discrete("A B")


But, my real code:

ggplot(data=lt4)+geom_line(aes(x=age_at_donation,
y=value*1000, colour=nadlergrp5,
group=nadlergrp5), size=0) +
geom_smooth(aes(x=age_at_donation, y=value*1000,
fill=nadlergrp5,group=nadlergrp5)) +
scale_colour_discrete("Estimated Blood Volume (Nadler)")

generates two legends... one entitled Nadler 5 and one (which is
strangely missing the colour blocks) entitled
"Estimated (new line) Blood (new line) Volume.

All I want is to re-title the Nadler 5 legend. Suggestions? I don't see
what is different between the prototype code and the
code I am running.

Hi Rob,

Look carefully at the aesthetic you are using vs. the scale you are
using. (Hint: fill and colour are different aesthetics)

Hadley
